info.name: Hide ChatGPT Logo Everywhere
info.description: This simple CSS style hides the "ChatGPT" text on the main page of chat.openai.com by targeting the specific <div> element with the class text-token-text-secondary. It was created just for testing purposes to understand how userstyles.org works. To use: copy the code, paste it into your user style manager like Stylish or Stylus, or add it directly on userstyles.org. Once applied, the "ChatGPT" text will no longer be visible. This style is a very basic test to explore custom CSS functionality.
